title: Gross income — Rafael Ortiz
instructions: Determine how much of each receipt Rafael Ortiz (single) includes in 2025 gross income.

exhibits.title: Receipts
exhibits.content:
1. Salary: **$80,000**
2. Interest on city bonds: **$2,000**
3. Cash gift from his aunt: **$10,000**
4. State income tax refund (he itemized last year and got a full benefit): **$1,200**
5. Life insurance proceeds on his father's death: **$100,000**
6. Alimony received under a 2020 divorce decree: **$12,000**
7. Taxable cost of group-term life coverage above $50,000 (per W-2): **$90**
8. State lottery winnings: **$5,000**
9. Unemployment compensation: **$4,000**

parts.prompt: Enter the amount included in gross income.

rows.label: 4. State tax refund
rows.explanation: Included under the tax benefit rule: **1,200**.

rows.label: 6. Alimony under a 2020 decree
rows.explanation: Post-2018 alimony isn't income to the recipient.
